rounds.text: Medico Intercontinental Ltd is currently mispriced by the market, as evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 0.52x, which sits significantly below the sector benchmark of 1.3x [E1, E6, E39]. The company is undergoing a clear operational turnaround, highlighted by a dramatic improvement in quarterly operating margins to 12% in September 2026 from -4% in the year-ago quarter [E24]. This efficiency is further supported by a reduction in working capital requirements from 121 days to 76.2 days [E40]. Despite historical volatility, the company generated substantial free cash flow of Rs 18.72 Cr in March 2026 [E29]. Furthermore, management has signaled confidence in this recovery by increasing their stake to 58.51% as of September 2026 [E34]. Conceded: the company faces significant headwinds including a 0.00% dividend yield, high leverage with a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.43x, and a poor five-year sales growth record [E3, E13, E30, E42].
